items.title: US dollar falls in Baghdad, Erbil

According to a Shafaq News market survey, the dollar traded in Baghdad's Al-Kifah and Al-Harithiya exchange markets at 165,700 dinars per 100 dollars, down from the morning session's 166,800 dinars. In the Iraqi capital, exchange shops sold the dollar at 166,250 dinars
